_what: What the presidential-suite builder (build_model.py, section 6) knows about the furniture in 'layout presidential test.dwg': which layers hold it, the office's own words for names the shared vocabulary (furniture/furniture_kit.py) cannot read, skip words, heights and bases. The same shape as the 'furniture' section of bank_project.json plus the layers (this builder has no layer-role file). Per-drawing facts live here; the code names no layer, block or coordinate. Keys that start with an underscore are notes. Decided on 29 Oct 2026 by looking at a picture of every candidate layer's pieces over the walls.
_layers: A block insert is a piece when its layer is one of these (the layer most of what is drawn in it is on). A-2.Noi That ('interior') is the main furniture layer; the two Cay layers hold the 12 tree symbols (a canopy circle and a trunk); the Fur$0$ layers belong to the bound furniture drawing (loose furniture, curtains, lamps) and the SANR layers to its fittings. A-4. Dim is the facade-line layer, yet three blocks on it read as furniture drawn on the wrong layer (two lounge chairs, each with a round side table, and an arched niche feature with a round stool); its loose lines are NOT furniture (looseLayers). Left out on purpose: DA-LATT-OTLN (the nine movable glass panels: already built as glass), the DA-DOOR-WIND layers (door symbols: the doors are cut as openings), KT-Lancan (the balustrade), KT-DIM (dimension blocks), A-1.Netcat - tuong (walls; its terrace daybed block is built as low walls), A-1.Netthay - manh (thin visible lines; its one block, a 0.7 m square with a cross in the shower room, reads as a floor drain) and Defpoints.
_looseLayers: Shapes drawn loose (not as a block) on these layers that touch within 1 cm form clusters; a cluster that fills 70 % of its rectangle is a box (dining tables, chairs and coffee tables of the terrace and the living room, the vanities, the bath tub, the kitchen counters). They carry no names, so they are all kind 'other'. A cluster that lies on a part built as structure (a pergola post) is that part's own drawing and is dropped.

heights._why: mm, only where this suite differs from the office defaults. plant: the 12 Cay symbols are tree and shrub canopies 0.5 - 2.2 m wide on the terraces (assumed 2.5 m; the drawing has no heights). curtain: the glass walls are 3.00 m floor to floor with a 0.25 m slab above, so a full-length curtain hangs to about 2.7 m (the 2.4 m default is for low windows).

bases._why: none. The lamps with nothing under them (the floor lamp by the bedroom sofa and the two lamps at the ends of the window bench) stand on the floor in the plan, so they keep base 0: a base of 1500 mm would hang them in the air. A lamp over a table or bedside table stands on it (the kit's supports).

words._why: The office's own words: names the vocabulary cannot read (anonymous blocks: the drawing's author named them 'sdhsdfhsdfh', '*U1636', 'A$C...'), matched whole against the family name, and they win over the vocabulary. Each is here only because the picture leaves no doubt what the block is; every other anonymous block stays 'other' and is listed in the report.
